notes.title: Gone Fishing is live!
notes.content:
[h1]Dear Golfers[/h1]

After weeks of silence, I'm proud to release the latest free DLC for Gone Golfing!

[h2]About[/h2]

Gone Fishing takes place after the horrific events of Golfmas and Golfmare.

You have become sick and tired of playing mini-golf and has now taken up another hobby, night fishing.
Equipped with a sturdy fishing rod and your fathers old fishing boat you set out to catch as many fish as you can.

But beware, the sea might not be as calm as it looks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38609694/51cfa3b686b7d3fda832ec490bd8637993594f98.png[/img]


[h2]What's new[/h2]

[list]
[*] New map/location
[*] Drivable boats
[*] Fishing mechanics
[*] Updated and expanded version of the great escape now called Golfmare
[*] New lore and Secrets
[*] New achievements
[*] Added steam cloud saves
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38609694/1c4fdd7396060913aa53fb775e9047c172eeb21f.jpg[/img]

I hope you all enjoy this DLC.
Until next time, cheers!
ICEHELM

notes.title: Gone Golfing Golfmare Update
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=vGFfLk8IZQY;full][/previewyoutube]

Greeting fellow mini golfers, the golfmare begins today!

This is the latest update of Gone Golfing which includes a update version of the great escape, now called Golfmare.

Golfmare expands on the same mode as the Golfmas, where the player gets 5 attempts to escape. However, this time he's not alone. Meet 2 new friends of Mr Golfy, both with with their own unique look and skills.  Both your stealth and golfing skills will be tested.

Be careful with the chests you find, you might not like its content.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38609694/a27526f537dee37acedae3292d033ef0256e293e.jpg[/img]

The Golfmare update contain various additions and fixes.

[list]
[*] Updated and expanded version of the great escape now called Golfmare
[*] Golfmare unlocked from the start
[*] Added charged swing for people with mouse and keyboard
[*] The enemies, which will test the player in different ways.
[*] New puzzles
[*] New and updated lore
[*] Secrets and new unlocks
[*] New achievements
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38609694/b416deeea3b159e56ffb55ea68a80564bb45ec4b.jpg[/img]


Cheers and good luck!
ICEHELM

notes.title: Alive and putting! New update is coming!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello fellow Golfers![/h1]

It's been 2 weeks since the release of the Merry Golfmas update, an update that received a lot of praise, but also shown that the game still has a few issues.

Worry not, Icehelm is dedicated to Gone Golfing and is currently working of fixing some of the biggest issues.

We're also expanding the game and remaking "the great escape" level.
The remade level will be unlocked for everyone and will feature new puzzles as well as a new enemy.

There will also be an update on the putting controls. A lot of people didn't like how the mouse swing mechanics worked so there will be an option to use hold-to-charge.

So stay tuned for further updates the coming weeks

Cheers
ICEHELM

notes.title: Gone Golfing Merry Golfmas
notes.content:
[h1]Ho Ho Ho! Merry Golfmas! [/h1]

[previewyoutube=nzWW8GIpLzM;full][/previewyoutube]

Hope everyone is having a great holiday season!
I want to start off by thanking everyone who has supported Gone Golfing, the launch has been amazing!

As a surprise, starting from today everyone who owns Gone Golfing can download Merry Golfmas for free!

Merry Golfmas is a Christmas inspired DLC that takes place during the winter season of Cozy Cove. Thinks have changed dramatically and the whole mini golf resort has taken a dark turn.

[h2]Merry Golfmas includes
[/h2]
[list]
[*] New puzzles
[*] Christmas themed enemies
[*] A whole new map with new challenges
[*] New lore
[*] New Achievements 
[/list]

But wait there is more!
Not only will the game contain a free DLC it will also come with update of the main game that fixes serval issues.

[list]
[*] Hole 4 has been remade to be a bit more forgiving.
[*] Levers in the warehouse are now easier to find.
[*] Fixed issue where you could drop the lever on an already working switch.
[*] No longer possible to get stuck on course 8.
[*] Blocked off parts of the map to prevent people from getting out of bounds.
[*] Improved collision on some models.
[*] Fixed spelling errors.
[*] Hitting object with the controller should now work as intended.
[*] Adjusted the golf swing to work better with low sense mouse input.

[/list]

[h3]Known issues[/h3]
[list]
[*] Dropping soda cans into the well on the Christmas level can soft-lock the game.
[/list]

I hope you all enjoy this little Christmas Gift.

Cheers and have a happy holidays!
